source_snapshot.procedure: Prepare the system specification and motherboard, then check that jumper positions follow the specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; a human visually verifies each jumper is present, seated and set.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; bind an exhaustive recipe-specific pin-bridge matrix, orientation and seating acceptance and preserve as-found state.

old_problem: The row did not provide the product recipe revision, complete per-jumper designator/pin-bridge/default/exception table, pin numbering/orientation, seating acceptance or explicit as-found/no-correction boundary.
disposition_reason: This source has an objective, safe inspection method once the SKU/recipe-specific jumper matrix is supplied. ED-03 allows expected designators, bridged pins and exceptions as runtime configuration, while ED-09 retains physical access and visual pin/seating evidence with a qualified human. Unlike row 2284, this row verifies actual shunt electrical-position geometry and seating, but it still does not authorize correction. The method, evidence, safety gate and recovery boundary are defined, so Pending is removed.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Functionality rows 2285 and 2287, including row-2285 Items, Procedure, Criteria and DeepSeek fields; row 2286 is outside this Pending queue and row 2287 is the verified next formal case.
Read GPT V2/historical record 2406 and retained the exact Source Key, Variant ID and original row hash.
Preserve every required jumper's setting/seating comparison and keep it separate from row-2284 header-location coverage.
Require oriented images showing numbered bridged pins and seating depth; an overview or header coordinate alone cannot prove state.
Any mismatch correction or reseat destroys as-found evidence and may alter boot/security behavior, so it remains a separately authorized action.
No chassis access, jumper movement, reset or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Complete motherboard jumper shunt setting and seating inspection
test_case.purpose: Verify every in-scope motherboard jumper shunt is present, fully seated and bridges the exact numbered pins/state required by the signed product recipe and SKU exception matrix, without altering the as-found configuration.
required_package: SUT, motherboard assembly/PCB revision and product recipe/SKU revision
Complete per-jumper designator, expected bridged pins/state/default and exception matrix
Defined shunt seating, damage and ambiguity acceptance criteria
Approved powered-down/discharged ESD access and indexed-photo procedure
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator establishes the approved de-energized/ESD state, verifies board and recipe revisions, and captures an oriented close-up for every in-scope jumper showing its designator, pin-1 reference, numbered pins bridged, shunt seating and nearby landmarks. Reconcile each actual state with the signed recipe/exception matrix, record missing, extra, loose, damaged, mis-set or ambiguous items, and leave every shunt untouched before restoring the chassis.
test_case.expected_result: Every required shunt is present, undamaged and fully seated across the exact approved pins/state for the applicable SKU, no unauthorized/extra shunt exists, all exceptions are traceable, and the as-found configuration remains unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete per-designator evidence with unambiguous pin numbering, correct bridge state, seating and applicable SKU exception. Correct header location alone, an overview that hides pins, assumed orientation, a loose shunt, an unexplained exception or correction performed before preserving as-found evidence is not PASS. The end engineer decides PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: De-energize/discharge the platform and use approved chassis and ESD controls.
Verify PCB and product-recipe revisions before comparing any setting.
Do not remove, reposition, reseat or probe a shunt under this inspection authorization.
Stop on ambiguous numbering, inaccessible/unsafe hardware, a loose/damaged shunt or evidence that the state was disturbed.
expected_evidence: Indexed oriented close-ups showing designator, pin-1, bridged pins and seating for every jumper
Per-designator actual-versus-expected reconciliation including loose/damaged/extra/missing findings
test_case.recovery: The inspection is no-touch. On a mismatch, loose/damaged shunt or uncertain pin numbering, preserve as-found images and stop. Any correction/reseat requires a separate maintenance authorization, impact assessment and its own before/after verification.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require jumper settings to follow the system specification.

blocked.reason: The manual setting/seating inspection is fully specified at review layer; recipe values and exceptions are runtime bindings.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: SUT/board/PCB and recipe/SKU revisions, complete per-jumper pin-bridge/default/exception matrix, pin orientation, seating criteria and safe ESD/photo procedure.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS A PARAMETERIZED MANUAL SETTING/SEATING INSPECTION; NO HARDWARE ACCESS EXECUTED
pending.owner: Board/product configuration owner supplies the recipe matrix; qualified operator captures physical evidence; end engineer owns the verdict.
pending.unlock_condition: Bind the signed recipe and complete matrix before inspection; any correction remains separately authorized.

project_authority: The motherboard product recipe and SKU exception control are authoritative for shunt pin bridges, defaults and allowed variants.
